sloka: त्रिभ्यो युगेभ्यस्त्रीन्वर्णान्धर्मश्च परिनिष्ठितः ।न शुद्धो लभते धर्मं युगतस्तु नरर्षभ ।हीनवर्णो नृपश्रेष्ठ तप्यते सुमहत्तपः ।। ७.७४.२६ ॥
transliteration: tribhyo yugebhyastrīnvarṇāndharmaśca pariniṣṭhitaḥ ।na śuddho labhate dharmaṁ yugatastu nararṣabha ।hīnavarṇo nṛpaśreṣṭha tapyate sumahattapaḥ ।। 7.74.26 ॥

translations.english: For the three ages (Krita, Treta, Dvapara), dharma is established for the three higher varnas, and a Shudra does not obtain religious merit by performing penance in these ages; yet, O best of kings, a person of lower caste is performing very great penance.
